title: Bug: test_TSA_B_C_with_no_neighbors failed due to BGP service restart limit
author: markx-arista
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

`bgp/test_traffic_shift.py::test_TSA_B_C_with_no_neighbors` failed after running new test case `bgp/test_prefix_list_suppress.py` because the BGP service restarts twice in both test cases.
If two tests run back to back, it hits the BGP service restart limit: 3 times in 20 minutes, configured by `StartLimitBurst=3` and `StartLimitIntervalSec=1200`:
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/blob/master/files/build_templates/per_namespace/bgp.service.j2#L12
The forth restart failed with:
```log
2026 Aug 10 19:15:21.818630 ldp106 WARNING systemd[1]: bgp.service: Start request repeated too quickly.
2026 Aug 10 19:15:21.818715 ldp106 WARNING systemd[1]: bgp.service: Failed with result 'exit-code'.
```

### Steps to Reproduce

Run `bgp/test_prefix_list_suppress.py` then `bgp/test_traffic_shift.py`

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Both tests should pass

Summary:
Running `test_prefix_list_suppress` before `test_TSA_B_C_with_no_neighbors` can exhaust BGP's 3 starts in 20-minute limit, configured by `StartLimitBurst=3` and `StartLimitIntervalSec=1200.`

Reset the counter before BGP restarts. `reset_service()` and `systemctl reset-failed` are equivalent here; one resolves the ASIC while the other uses its resolved service name.

Fixes #26940
